metadata.title: Solvability of complex Hessian equations corresponding to right-Noetherian polynomials
metadata.abstract: On compact Hermitian manifolds, we establish a framework using radial normalization for the solvability of complex Hessian equation in form type, corresponding to right-Noetherian polynomials whose coefficients may not be constant functions. The solvability of a radial normalized equation is characterized by the existence of a C-subsolution at radial slope, which extends the results of Guo-Song to this setting.

analysis.topic: 几何分析、几何 PDE 与几何流
analysis.progressType: 复 Hessian 方程可解性
analysis.workSummary: 在紧 Hermitian 流形上，用径向归一化研究对应右 Noetherian 多项式的 form-type 复 Hessian 方程，允许系数随位置变化，以径向斜率处的 C-subsolution 刻画可解性。
analysis.breakthrough: 把 Guo–Song 框架推广到新的多项式与变系数设置。
analysis.limitations: 依据官方摘要和作者评论的摘要级分析，尚未审读完整证明。摘要未列出多项式 admissibility 和归一化的全部条件，不能概括为任意全非线性方程均可解。 AI 披露另见独立全文核查。
analysis.aiEvidence: 工具披露说明 ChatGPT 6-Astra 用于文献综述、对抗性审读和论证文字改善，并建议将式 (18) 用于径向归一化。记录这一明确的研究路线建议及文献、检查和写作辅助；作者仍承担结果正确性责任。
analysis.aiEvidenceSource: https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.22524v1 · PDF 第 5 页，Tool and computational resource disclosure
